rgbds_note: upstream .rgbds-version says 1.0.0, but v1.0.3 reproduces the release ROM byte-for-byte (verified 2026-10-04), so no 1.0.0 pin was added
make_args_note: w64devkit gcc has no LTO; tools/Makefile hard-codes -flto. CFLAGS=-O2 (command-line, propagates to the tools sub-make) only affects the host helper tools, never the ROM
